tag: 三大指數收黑：那斯達克 -1.88%、標普 -1.11%、道瓊 -0.09%
zh: 週三（10/14）9 月 CPI 高於預期，美股科技領跌：路透報道那斯達克收 26,692.87（-1.88%，7/23 以來最大單日跌幅）、標普 500 收 7,718.94（-1.11%，7/29 以來最大跌幅）、道瓊收 51,621.48（-0.09%）。羅素 2000 一個彙整頁列為 2,729.54（-1.93%），但我只找到單一來源，視為暫定數字。那斯達克與道瓊的跌幅差達 1.79 個百分點，是 7/2 以來最大的差距。
en: On Wednesday (Oct. 14) a hotter-than-expected September CPI hit tech: per Reuters the Nasdaq fell 1.88% to 26,692.87 (its biggest one-day drop since July 23), the S&P 500 lost 1.11% to 7,718.94 and the Dow slipped 0.09% to 51,621.48. One summary put the Russell 2000 at 2,729.54 (-1.93%), but it is a single source and provisional. The 1.79-point gap between the Nasdaq and Dow is the widest since July 2.

stocks.n: 那斯達克 100 ETF，綜合指數 -1.88%
道瓊 ETF，指數僅 -0.09%
羅素 2000 ETF，指數約 -1.93%（暫定）

tag: AI 基礎設施股重挫：CoreWeave -15%、Oracle -8.8%、Nvidia -3%
zh: CPI 之後最痛的是 AI 基礎設施：據 Reuters 彙整，Nvidia 跌逾 3%，Oracle 跌約 8.8%，CoreWeave 與 Nebius 分別跌約 15% 與 10%。分析師的解讀是這類公司靠舉債擴張、對利率最敏感，市場同時在問 AI 資本支出何時能回收。蘋果逆勢漲逾 1%，是科技股裡少數收紅的大型股。
en: The pain after CPI was concentrated in AI infrastructure: per Reuters, Nvidia fell more than 3%, Oracle about 8.8%, and CoreWeave and Nebius roughly 15% and 10%. Analysts pointed to heavy debt funding and rate sensitivity, plus doubts about when AI spending pays back. Apple rose more than 1%, a rare gainer in tech.

stocks.n: AI 晶片龍頭，跌逾 3%
雲端與資料中心，跌約 8.8%
AI 雲端算力租賃，跌約 15%，負債是焦點
AI 雲端基礎設施，跌約 10%
逆勢漲逾 1%

tag: 殖利率與油價同步上行：十年期約 5.3%、WTI 約 95 美元
zh: CPI 公布後債券殖利率跳升：CNBC 報道十年期殖利率一度上升 10 個基點到 5.323%，兩年期升逾 10 個基點到 4.89%。不同媒體時間點不同，十年期落在 5.22% 至 5.32% 之間，這裡不把單一數字當收盤。油價同步偏高：Schwab 頁面列 WTI 約 95.66 美元，OPEC+ 上週維持 11 月產量目標不變。
en: After CPI, bond yields jumped: CNBC reported the 10-year up 10 basis points to 5.323% at one point and the 2-year up more than 10 bps to 4.89%. Quotes vary by timestamp (5.22%-5.32% for the 10-year), so none is treated as the close. Oil stayed high, with WTI around $95.66 per Schwab, after OPEC+ held November output targets.

stocks.n: 20 年期以上公債 ETF，殖利率上升對價格不利
7-10 年期公債 ETF，十年期殖利率的直接對照
原油 ETF，WTI 約 95 美元的參照
能源板塊 ETF，油價高檔的受惠方向

tag: 盤勢結構：下跌集中在科技，漲跌家數接近持平
zh: 這次下跌不是全面性的：3:59 p.m. 時標普 500 成分股有 245 檔上漲、256 檔下跌，幾乎對半，道瓊也只跌 0.09%。資金是從高估值、靠借貸的 AI 與半導體撤出，而不是整個市場倒貨。對照昨天（10/13）三大指數只小跌 0.02% 至 0.35%，這是財報季開跑以來第一次出現明顯的科技單邊賣壓。
en: The decline was narrow: at 3:59 p.m. 245 S&P 500 members were up and 256 down, almost even, and the Dow lost just 0.09%. Money left richly valued, debt-funded AI and semiconductor names rather than the whole market. Tuesday's moves were only -0.02% to -0.35%, so this is the first clear one-way tech selloff of the earnings season.

stocks.n: 標普 500 等權重 ETF，用來對照市值加權的差距
費城半導體 ETF，晶片板塊整體
科技板塊 ETF，下跌的主要來源

tag: 美國銀行財報：含 12 億罰款獲利 -17%，股價跌近 5%
zh: 美國銀行（BAC）第三季獲利年減 17% 到 69.3 億美元、每股 0.91 美元，其中包含 12 億美元的監管罰款，扣除後每股約 1.08 美元。營收 301.2 億美元低於 LSEG 預期的 306.9 億，固定收益與股票交易合計短少約 7.5 億美元；淨利息收入 +7.9% 到 166 億美元則略優於預期。股價週三跌近 5%。前一天富國銀行（WFC）每股盈餘 1.87 美元小勝預期 1.85，但營收與淨利息收入略低於預期。
en: Bank of America's Q3 profit fell 17% to $6.93 billion, or $0.91 a share, including a $1.2 billion regulatory penalty (about $1.08 excluding it). Revenue of $30.12 billion missed the $30.69 billion LSEG estimate, with fixed income and equities trading about $750 million short; net interest income rose 7.9% to $16.6 billion, slightly ahead. Shares fell almost 5%. A day earlier Wells Fargo's $1.87 EPS beat $1.85 but revenue and NII were light.

stocks.n: 本日財報主角，營收未達預期、股價跌近 5%
10/13 財報 EPS 1.87 小勝，營收略低
金融板塊 ETF，銀行股分化的整體對照

tag: 摩根士丹利財報：股票交易 +41%，財富管理淨流入創紀錄
zh: 摩根士丹利（MS）第三季每股盈餘 3.03 美元，高於 LSEG 預期的 2.91；淨收入 203.4 億美元，年增約 12%。主力是股票交易，FinanceFeeds 報道年增 41% 到 58 億美元，高於預期 9.09 億美元。財富管理單季淨新增資產 2,320 億美元，Bloomberg 稱為紀錄。在 CPI 後波動升高的環境，交易收入是這類財報的亮點，但我沒有找到當日股價的最終漲跌幅。
en: Morgan Stanley's Q3 EPS of $3.03 beat the $2.91 LSEG consensus on net revenue of $20.34 billion (+12%). Equities trading rose 41% to $5.8 billion, beating expectations by $909 million per FinanceFeeds, and wealth management took in a record $232 billion of net new assets per Bloomberg. I could not confirm the share-price move at the close.

stocks.n: 本日財報：EPS 3.03 勝預期，交易與財富管理雙強
大型投行，同樣受益交易活絡（財報已於前日公布）
財富與券商同業，10/15 盤前公布財報

tag: ASML 第三季：營收 117 億歐元，第四季財測上看 142–152 億
zh: ASML 公布第三季淨銷售 117 億歐元（落在財測 110 億至 120 億的上緣）、淨利 50 億歐元、毛利率 57.5%。第四季財測為 142 億至 152 億歐元、毛利率約 57%；全年淨銷售預期 440 億至 450 億歐元。ASML 今年起不再公布單季訂單，所以「訂單是否超預期」這個老指標看不到。我沒有找到財報後的股價反應，投資人要看的是財測跳升是否被視為 AI 資本支出的延續。
en: ASML reported Q3 net sales of EUR 11.7 billion (upper end of the EUR 11-12 billion guide), net income of EUR 5.0 billion and a 57.5% gross margin. Q4 guidance is EUR 14.2-15.2 billion at roughly 57% margin, and full-year sales EUR 44-45 billion. The company stopped reporting quarterly bookings this year, so the old order-beat gauge is gone. I found no post-results share reaction.

stocks.n: EUV 曝光機龍頭，Q4 財測 142–152 億歐元
半導體設備同業，Lam 預計 10/21 財報
半導體設備同業，對資本支出循環敏感

tag: 9 月 CPI：整體 3.7%、核心 2.6%，雙雙高於預期
zh: BLS 公布 9 月整體 CPI 年增 3.7%（Dow Jones 預期 3.6%）、月增 0.6%；核心 CPI 月增 0.3%、年增 2.6%，高於預期的 0.2% 與 2.5%。汽油較 8 月大漲 9.1%，是三月伊朗戰爭爆發以來最大單月漲幅；食品雜貨則 -0.1%。這份報告是期中選舉前最後一份 CPI，核心通膨高於預期，代表升息壓力不只來自能源。
en: BLS reported September headline CPI up 3.7% year over year (consensus 3.6%) and 0.6% on the month; core rose 0.3% m/m and 2.6% y/y versus 0.2% and 2.5% expected. Gasoline jumped 9.1% from August, the largest monthly rise since the Iran war began in March, while groceries slipped 0.1%. It is the last CPI before the midterms, and a firm core print means rate pressure is not just energy.

stocks.n: 抗通膨公債 ETF，通膨預期的直接對照
能源板塊 ETF，汽油與油價推升通膨的上游
羅素 2000 ETF，對利率與通膨預期敏感

tag: 升息賭盤升溫：10 月加息機率約 39%，FOMC 10/27–28
zh: Fed 已在 9/16 升息一碼到 3.75% 至 4.00%，是 2023 年以來第一次，會議紀錄顯示多數官員認為年底前還需要再升一次。CPI 後 CME FedWatch 顯示 10 月升息機率約 39%，公布前約 22%（另一份分析給 45%，口徑不同）。上週偏軟的 9 月就業數據曾把 10 月升息機率壓到 20% 以下，這份 CPI 把它拉了回來。下次 FOMC 在 10/27 至 28 日。
en: The Fed raised rates a quarter point to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept. 16, its first hike since 2023, and minutes showed most officials see another one as appropriate by year-end. After CPI, CME FedWatch put the odds of an October hike near 39%, from about 22% before the release (another analysis says 45%). The soft jobs report had pushed October odds below 20%; CPI pulled them back. The next FOMC is Oct. 27-28.

stocks.n: 1-3 年期公債 ETF，政策利率預期的敏感端
區域銀行 ETF，存放利差與信用成本兩面受影響
公用事業 ETF，利率敏感的防禦股

tag: 債市壓力：十年期創本輪高點，海外機構開始避險
zh: 上週十年期殖利率一度到 5.36% 的本輪高點，週末收在約 5.25%，SWBC 形容為劇烈波動後的整理。Bloomberg 報道，債券策略師 Harley Bassman 警告期貨交割機制中一個少被注意的特性，可能放大這輪長達數月的賣壓；英國 L&G 則在 10/14 表示正替債券買入避險，理由包括超大型雲端業者的 AI 借款、各國政府債務與升息可能。債券是 CPI 之後科技股被賣的背景。
en: The 10-year yield touched a cycle high of 5.36% last week before ending near 5.25%, which SWBC called consolidation after sharp moves. Bloomberg reported strategist Harley Bassman warning that a little-noticed futures-delivery feature could amplify the monthslong selloff, and Legal & General said on Oct. 14 it is hedging its bond purchases, citing hyperscaler AI borrowing, government debt and possible rate hikes. Bonds are the backdrop to the post-CPI tech selloff.

stocks.n: 長天期公債 ETF，殖利率高點的最直接對照
放空長天期公債的反向 ETF，賭殖利率續升
房貸證券 ETF，房貸利率傳導的對照

tag: 能源：汽油 +9.1%、WTI 約 95 美元，通膨與獲利同時被推高
zh: CPI 裡汽油月增 9.1%，油價在 90 美元上方，能源是這輪通膨的主因，也是少數在科技殺盤時有支撐的板塊。Brent 上週收在 102 美元之上，OPEC+ 維持 11 月產量目標不變。能源類股的邏輯是現金流隨油價走，但油價高也直接傳導到通膨與升息預期，對其他板塊是負面。這裡只講板塊方向，沒有查到 10/14 當日能源類股的實際漲跌幅。
en: Gasoline rose 9.1% in the CPI and oil is above $90, making energy the main driver of this inflation wave and one of the few supports while tech sold off. Brent ended last week above $102 and OPEC+ held November targets. Energy cash flows follow crude, but high oil also feeds inflation and rate-hike expectations for everything else. I did not find the sector's actual Oct. 14 move.

stocks.n: 能源板塊 ETF，油價高檔的代表
油氣探勘生產 ETF，對油價槓桿更大
油服 ETF，鑽井與服務商的對照

tag: 科技內部分化：AI 基礎設施被賣，蘋果相對抗跌
zh: 同樣是科技，蘋果漲逾 1%，Oracle、CoreWeave、Nebius 重挫，市場在分辨誰靠自有現金流、誰靠借貸擴張。ASML 剛公布第四季財測 142 億至 152 億歐元，說明設備端的實際需求仍強，但 AI 資本支出能否回收，是升息環境下被重新定價的問題。留意本週 TSMC（10/15）與下週 Lam、德儀、IBM 的財報，會是檢驗 AI 需求的下一批證據。
en: Within tech, Apple rose more than 1% while Oracle, CoreWeave and Nebius sank, as the market separates companies funded by own cash flow from those funded by debt. ASML's Q4 guide of EUR 14.2-15.2 billion shows equipment demand is still strong, but the payback on AI capex is being repriced in a rising-rate world. TSMC (Oct. 15) and next week's Lam, Texas Instruments and IBM reports are the next evidence.

stocks.n: 現金流型科技股，逆勢漲逾 1%
10/15 盤前財報，AI 晶片需求的檢驗
類比晶片，據行事曆預計 10/21 盤後財報

tag: 房屋營建：十年期 5.3% 下，Lennar 創 52 週低點
zh: 殖利率衝到 5.3% 上下，對房貸利率與購屋需求是直接壓力。Lennar（LEN）據報道在某個週一重挫 7% 到 74.44 美元、創 52 週新低，起因是 Hunterbrook 報告質疑它與 Millrose Properties 的往來（報道日期不明確，請自行確認）。同一時間 Berkshire 10/1 至 2 日買進約 1.93 億美元 Lennar 股票，兩股力量拉扯：利率壓著需求，大戶在低檔加碼。
en: With the 10-year near 5.3%, mortgage rates and housing demand face direct pressure. Lennar reportedly fell 7% to $74.44, a new 52-week low, after a Hunterbrook report questioned its dealings with Millrose Properties (the exact date was unclear in reports). Meanwhile Berkshire bought about $193 million of Lennar on Oct. 1-2: rates weigh on demand while a large holder adds at the lows.

stocks.n: 大型建商，創 52 週低點、Berkshire 加碼
最大建商，同樣受房貸利率影響
房屋營建 ETF，板塊整體

tag: 羅素 2000 單日 -1.9%：小型股對利率最敏感
zh: 羅素 2000 週三約收 2,729.54（-1.93%，單一來源、暫定），前一天為 2,786.13。Royce 的統計顯示第三季羅素 2000 下跌 7.2%，截至 9/30 今年仍上漲 13.7%。小型股的特性是負債中浮動利率比例較高、獲利波動較大，所以十年期殖利率衝上 5.3% 時，小型股的反應通常比大型股強。這是一般性判讀，不是對今天資料的證明。
en: The Russell 2000 closed near 2,729.54 (-1.93%, single source, provisional) versus 2,786.13 on Tuesday. Royce says the index fell 7.2% in Q3 and was still up 13.7% for the year through Sept. 30. Small caps tend to carry more floating-rate debt and more volatile earnings, so a 10-year near 5.3% usually hits them harder than large caps. That is a general read, not proof from today's data.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，小型股基準
標普 600 小型股 ETF，獲利門檻較嚴的對照
羅素 2000 的另一檔追蹤 ETF

tag: 區域銀行週五登場：TFC、RF、CFG、MTB 隱含波動遠高於歷史
zh: 10/16（週五）盤前 Truist（TFC）、Regions（RF）、Citizens（CFG）、M&T（MTB）與旅行家（TRV）公布財報，選擇權隱含波動 8.0%、7.7%、7.3%、6.8%、6.5%，都明顯高於各自十年平均約 4% 至 5%。原因可以從本週看出來：BAC 營收未達、MS 交易強，加上殖利率上升同時壓縮債券損益與推升存款成本，市場對區域銀行的不確定性偏高。這些數字是 10/14 的選擇權定價，會隨價格變動。
en: On Friday (Oct. 16) before the open, Truist, Regions, Citizens, M&T and Travelers report. Options imply moves of 8.0%, 7.7%, 7.3%, 6.8% and 6.5%, well above their roughly 4%-5% ten-year averages. This week's mixed bank results (BAC revenue miss, MS trading strength) and rising yields, which hit bond marks and deposit costs, explain the uncertainty. Figures are Oct. 14 option pricing and will move.

stocks.n: 區域銀行 ETF
Truist，隱含波動 ±8.0%
Regions，隱含波動 ±7.7%
Citizens，隱含波動 ±7.3%
M&T Bank，隱含波動 ±6.8%

tag: CoreWeave 與 Nebius：高負債 AI 雲端在高殖利率下被重新定價
zh: CoreWeave 週三跌約 15%、Nebius 跌約 10%，分析師的重點是它們靠大量借款購買 GPU 並出租算力，債務成本直接吃掉毛利。殖利率上升時，這類公司的再融資成本與估值都會被重算；它們屬於中型成長股，不是傳統小型股，但常被當成 AI 風險偏好的溫度計。我沒有查到兩家最新的負債與合約細節，所以這裡只談對利率的敏感度，不談基本面好壞。
en: CoreWeave fell about 15% and Nebius about 10%. Analysts focused on how both borrow heavily to buy GPUs and rent out compute, so debt cost eats directly into margin. Higher yields reset refinancing cost and valuation; they are mid-cap growth names rather than classic small caps, but often serve as a gauge of AI risk appetite. I found no fresh debt or contract details, so this speaks to rate sensitivity only, not fundamentals.

stocks.n: AI 算力出租商，跌約 15%
AI 雲端基礎設施商，跌約 10%
AI 伺服器廠，同屬 AI 硬體風險偏好的對照

tag: Sonic Automotive：10/7 內部人買進約 129 萬美元，UBS 目標價降到 74
zh: 汽車經銷商 Sonic Automotive（SAH）被報道有內部人在 10/7 買進約 129 萬美元股票，Investing.com 標題寫董事 Paul Rusnak，TipRanks 描述他是大股東，職稱說法不一，我沒有找到原始 Form 4，張數與價格未能確認。同一頁顯示 UBS 把目標價從 107 降到 74 美元、評級維持買進。SAH 是中小型股，內部人在目標價被大幅下修時買進，是值得追蹤的反向訊號，但不一定代表底部。
en: Sonic Automotive (SAH) saw an insider buy of about $1.29 million on Oct. 7. Investing.com headlined it as director Paul Rusnak while TipRanks calls him a significant holder; titles conflict, and I could not find the Form 4, so share count and price are unconfirmed. The same page shows UBS cutting its target to $74 from $107 with a Buy rating. A purchase after a steep target cut is a contrarian signal worth tracking, not proof of a bottom.

stocks.n: 汽車經銷商，內部人 10/7 買進約 129 萬美元
二手車零售同業，用於對照產業景氣
AutoNation，經銷商同業對照

tag: 判讀小型股：同叫「小型股」，羅素 2000 與標普 600 的池子不一樣
zh: 看小型股數字時先分清楚基準：羅素 2000 依市值排名納入，包含不少尚未獲利的公司；標普 600 則要求財報有獲利才能納入，品質門檻較高。所以利率上升、融資變貴的日子，沒有獲利、要靠再融資的公司通常在羅素 2000 裡壓力較大，兩個指數的漲跌可能不同步。另外小型股買賣價差較寬、成交量薄，內部人買進或財報的股價反應常被放大，看到單日大漲大跌時，要先查成交量。這是一般性的判讀知識，不是今天的新聞。
en: Before reading a small-cap number, check the benchmark: the Russell 2000 is rank-based and includes many unprofitable companies, while the S&P 600 requires positive earnings to be added, a higher quality bar. On days when rates rise and financing gets pricier, unprofitable names that rely on refinancing tend to be pressured more in the Russell 2000, so the two indexes can diverge. Small caps also have wider bid-ask spreads and thinner volume, which amplifies reactions to insider buying or earnings; check volume before reading a big one-day move. This is general reading guidance, not today's news.

en: Borr Drilling (BORR) leases jackup rigs. Aiman Demircan's insider weekly says director Tor Olav Troim (a founder) bought on three straight sessions through a family trust: about 4.25 million shares, roughly $18 million, at $4.13-$4.31 with no 10b5-1 plan. Q1 results showed 71% of 2026 covered at an average dayrate near $137,000; the Odin rig began earning on Sept. 11 and Idun's Vietnam contract starts in Q4. Risks: heavy debt, and dayrates lag oil by 6-12 months. Research lead, not advice.

tag: 判讀卡：政要申報為什麼不是買賣訊號
zh: STOCK Act 允許申報延遲 45 天，所以看到的是一個半月前的決定，等你看到時價格早已不同。金額只是寬區間（例如 1,000 至 15,000 美元），沒有精確數字；許多交易由配偶或信託帳戶執行，不一定是本人決策。選擇權才是資訊量大的一類：履約價與到期日顯示對方押什麼價位、多久內，例如 2027 年到期的 Intel 買權就是一年半的主題押注。這個頻道只描述誰申報了什麼，不暗示內線，也不是跟單依據。
en: The STOCK Act allows a 45-day reporting lag, so you see a decision made six weeks ago at a price that has since moved. Amounts are wide ranges (e.g. $1,000-$15,000), not exact figures, and many trades are made by a spouse or trust account rather than the member. Options carry the most information: strike and expiry show the price level and time frame being bet on, as with the 2027 Intel calls. This channel only describes who reported what; it implies no insider trading and is not a copy-trade guide.

tag: 今日值得注意的一件事：市場在重新定價「用借的錢蓋 AI」
zh: 今天的訊號不是通膨本身，而是核心 CPI 高於預期後，被賣最重的是 CoreWeave（-15%）、Oracle（-8.8%）這類靠債務擴張的 AI 基礎設施，而不是整個市場：標普 500 漲跌家數幾乎持平。與此同時 ASML 把第四季財測拉到 142 億至 152 億歐元，說明實體需求還在。所以市場並不是在懷疑需求，而是在問十年期殖利率到 5.3% 之後，借錢買 GPU 的帳還算不算得過來。若下一份 PPI 或零售銷售再偏熱，這個問題只會更尖銳。開放式問題：如果要分辨「AI 需求還在」與「AI 融資不划算」，你會看哪三個數字？
en: Today's signal is not inflation itself: after a firm core CPI the heaviest selling hit debt-funded AI infrastructure such as CoreWeave (-15%) and Oracle (-8.8%), not the whole market, as S&P 500 breadth was almost even. At the same time ASML lifted its Q4 guide to EUR 14.2-15.2 billion, showing physical demand is intact. The market is not doubting demand; it is asking whether borrowing to buy GPUs still pencils out with the 10-year near 5.3%. A hot PPI or retail sales print would sharpen that. Open question: which three numbers would you watch to tell 'AI demand is intact' from 'AI financing no longer pays'?
